opening.argument: The presentation is structured as a consumer warning about Uber gift cards and related payment concerns. The title states “Dont buy Uber gift cards and gift card information,” and the speaker tells consumers to beware of an alleged scam involving the cards: “what's happening about these cards it's legit with the scam so consumer beware.” The guidance is specifically to avoid the cards and credit or debit details, while using a prepaid Visa card instead: “Don't buy these uber cards Just get your visa gift card Put it on uber Don't put your credit card Don't put your debit card number on there.” Reports that others were scammed are expressly attributed to what the speaker heard, and the claimed $60 loss is presented as personal experience; neither independently establishes the alleged transactions, losses, or Uber's practices.
